{{Quote|Blackroot...to replenish the body.|Mother Talzin, Shaman of the Nightsisters|<ref name="Monster" />}}
'''Blackroot''' was a rejuvenating beverage,<ref name="Monster" /> brewed from boiled [[Blackroot (plant)|blackroot]].<ref name="BoS" /> Drinking blackroot was thought to replenish the body, and was, at [[Time/Legends|times]], offered to individuals after a long journey.<ref name="Monster" /> [[Shaman of the Nightsisters|Shamans]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]<ref name="BoS" />—a clan of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|wielding]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]<ref name="CoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>—were capable of conjuring goblets of blackroot using the power of raw [[Spirit ichor/Legends|spirit ichor]], the alchemical base of all [[Dathomir Magic|magic]] performed by the [[Witch/Legends|witches]]. The leader of the of the Nightsister [[Coven/Legends|coven]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], touched upon the ability to summon blackroot through the use of [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|spirit]] ichor in her Nightsister manifesto, "''[[Wild Power]]''," noting it to be a blessing of the [[Daughter/Legends|Winged Goddess]].<ref name="BoS" />

After the presumed [[Death/Legends|death]] of his one-time apprentice, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] traveled to Dathomir in search of a replacement. There, he was received by Mother Talzin at the Nightsisters' [[Nightsister fortress|lair]], and offered a goblet of blackroot the [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] conjured for him in order to replenish himself after the journey from distant [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].<ref name="Monster" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blackroot was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the thirteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], entitled "[[Monster]]."<ref name="Monster" /> The beverage takes its name from a substance of the same name in ''Star Wars'' creator [[George Lucas]]' 1988 fantasy film [[Willow (film)|''Willow'']].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Monster">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode313.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Monster}}</ref> The drink received further mention in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-oriented reference book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Daniel Wallace]] and published [[February 10]], [[2012]].<ref name="BoS" />
